title: Flower arrangements
description: Pick a form, add flowers from the florists' catalogues and see the proportions and the indicative cost. When you are happy, ask for a quote.

list.title: Your designs
list.emptyBody: Start with a form and a few flowers. You can save as many variants as you like.

designer.name: Name of the design
designer.previewNote: A sketch of proportion and colour, not a picture of the finished arrangement.
designer.itemsEmptyBody: Add your first flowers from the florists' catalogues.
designer.inSeason: in season in the occasion's month
designer.outSeason: out of season in the occasion's month
designer.noteHint: Style, size, what to avoid. It travels with the quote request.
designer.readOnly: You can see the arrangements, but only the organisers can change them.
designer.archiveBody: It leaves the list. Its versions and linked quotes stay in the history.

picker.title: Flowers from the catalogues
picker.seasonOnly: Only what is in season in the occasion's month
picker.noneBody: Try another word or take off the season filter.
picker.noCataloguesBody: When a florist publishes its flowers, you find them here.

cost.label: Indicative cost — not a quote
cost.noteFull: Stems × the price per stem published by the florists. The real price is set by the quote.
cost.notePartial: At least this much: {count} of the items have no published price per stem and are not counted as zero.
cost.noteNone: None of the items has a published price per stem ({count}). You learn the cost from the quote.

quote.title: Ask for a quote
quote.body: The florist receives only the arrangement (form, varieties, stem counts, your note), the occasion date, the approximate number of guests and your message. Your email goes only if you tick the box.
quote.send: Ask for a quote for version {version}
quote.sent: The request is sent. You will find the reply under suppliers.
quote.saveFirst: Save the design first; the request goes out for the saved version.
quote.changedBody: The accepted quote from {listing} answers version {quoted}; the design is now at version {current}. What changed:

whatif.costNote: Indicative cost from published prices — not a quote.

errors.stems: The stem count must be between 1 and 500.
errors.tooMany: A design can have at most 24 varieties.
errors.tooManyStems: A design can have at most {max} stems in total.
errors.itemGone: One of the varieties is no longer published in a catalogue. Take it out and save again.
errors.tooManyDesigns: You have reached the limit of {max} designs per occasion. Archive one to make room.
